baseline_findings_summary: All 7 web shells render with bare viewport meta — no viewport-fit=cover, no theme-color, no apple-touch-icon, no PWA manifest link, no service-worker link.
All 6 workspace shells render with placeholder workspace IDs (no server-side validation); client-side fetch returns 401 unauthenticated and surfaces the error via showError().
API authentication boundary works: 401 with structured error envelope for protected /v1/* routes.
PWA assets completely absent: 9 candidate paths all 404.
No mobile-specific CSS: 0 safe-area, 0 touch-action, 0 @media (hover: none), 0 @media (pointer: coarse) anywhere in served HTML.
CSP is permissive: script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'. Service worker registration will require CSP revisiting (service worker install needs script-src 'self' without 'unsafe-inline' OR nonce-based).
OpenAPI contract not served from /openapi.yaml (404); contract exists at api/openapi.yaml on disk.
Largest page (conversation detail) is 21,841 bytes uncompressed; for mobile networks this is the primary payload concern.
